drill: What is written first in a dApp?
The states and legal transitions
What cannot be changed after launch?
The deployed contract's code
What does consensus guarantee?
Agreement on order and finality — not truth
What does a miner vary?
The block header nonce
What does the nonce search produce?
Nothing useful — work buys the right to propose
What is the reward?
The block subsidy plus transaction fees
Which validation check is last?
State root matching the committed root
Why check the parent hash early?
It is cheap and rejects a wrong-chain block at once
What does a contract account store?
Balance, nonce, code hash, storage root
Why is the trie hashed?
Any change yields a new root, enabling compact proofs
How is a Swarm chunk named?
By the hash of its content
Does Swarm need ordering consensus?
No — only agreement that a chunk matches its hash
What does Swarm pay for?
Storing and serving chunks
What do postage stamps buy?
A prepaid storage period
